items.label: VexLife Web Search Refinement
items.purpose: Give the canonical Vex Companion a truthful bounded public-web research path that reuses the existing capability runtime, scheduler and ToolResultRelay; keep external content untrusted, make all actual provider input share one context budget, preserve source-addressed evidence while temporary raw observations can leave active context, and prove one natural same-Conversation research turn without making web evidence a second Memory or authority owner.

items.label: Preparation — map web research through current VexArchitecture
items.purpose: Before provider implementation, map the bounded public-web research intention through the current New Beginnings/Interface Refinement semantic owners: capability need/admission, one final provider-boundary Context Lease budget, source admission, untrusted external observation, ToolResultRelay return, transient observation lifetime, working-context rollover, same-Conversation synthesis and VexBoard projectability. Preserve search vs fetch and public GitHub read vs authenticated/write authority as distinct questions where meaning would otherwise be lost. This work creates no network effect or provider authority.

items.label: Unify provider-boundary context budget and transient observation lifecycle
items.purpose: Make the real model input budget account for canonical Conversation/Memory materialization plus Foundation/Atlas/currentContext, capability request/synthesis instructions and active tool observations as one provider-boundary token budget. Add a system-owned transient-observation lifecycle so large raw web evidence can leave active model context after bounded reduction while exact source/observation refs remain available for rehydration; do not make the model responsible for manual cleanup.

items.label: Bind safe bounded public-web search and fetch reads
items.purpose: Add the smallest provider-neutral public-web read surface needed for Vex to search for current information and fetch selected public sources through the existing capability runtime. Treat every returned webpage/snippet as untrusted external content rather than instruction or authority; require public HTTP/HTTPS destination admission, redirect revalidation, bounded time/bytes/content types, no implicit credentials or local-network reachability, source/currentness provenance and exact ToolResultRelay-compatible observations.

items.label: Prove one lived natural web-research turn
items.purpose: Prove the user-facing threshold in the canonical durable Conversation: Victor asks a natural question requiring current public information; Vex recognizes the admitted web-read capability, obtains bounded source-addressed search/fetch observations, keeps external prompt-injection text non-authoritative, receives results through ToolResultRelay, synthesizes a grounded answer, and the same Conversation remains current across completion/re-entry.

items.label: Potential — transient multi-source research working set
items.purpose: If real multi-source web use proves direct bounded observations insufficient, earn the smallest reusable mechanism that lets raw source observations remain externally addressable while active model context retains compact claim/evidence/currentness/contradiction packets and can rehydrate exact evidence on demand. Do not create this as a second Memory, semantic-truth or research-authority system before repeated pressure demonstrates the need.
